meta.note: GW/load multipliers and overbuild metrics for all 7 ISOs × 4 pathways × 5 endpoints. Installed GW derived from annual buildout TWh via capacity factors. Gas remaining = existing_gas_capacity_gw - gas_retired_gw at endpoint year. L/M/H demand variants from data-demand-L, base, data-demand-H directories.
meta.overbuild_definition: gw_per_gw_peak = (total_new_build_gw + gas_remaining_gw) / peak_demand_gw_2050. Includes all new-build resources plus existing gas not yet retired at endpoint.
meta.gas_definition: gas_remaining_gw = max(0, EXISTING_GAS_CAPACITY_GW - gas_retired_cumulative_gw). This is legacy fleet capacity, not new-build gas.
meta.clean_firm_definition: new_build_clean_firm_gw includes ccs_ccgt + uprate resources. Pathway 1: always 0 (clean firm locked). Pathways 2a/2b/3: unlocks post-pivot or from year 1.
